data.title: Consolidate reviewed stack and CI acceptance [no release] [no deploy]
data.body:
## Purpose

The reviewed PatchTrace consolidation stack remains in draft branches, while retained Linux frozen-CLI and archive-cache changes needed actual-source verification. This PR brings that stack and the reviewed CI repairs into one main-integration candidate, restores engineering records omitted by sibling reconciliation, and preserves an explicit deployment hold.

## Changes

- Retain the PR #345–#348 application lineage and prior independent review/evidence. The application `src/` tree is unchanged from hosted-qualified PR #348.
- Run the full existing frozen CLI harness on the checksum-verified extracted Linux artifact on Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04, retaining offscreen and Xvfb probes. The harness runtime AST is unchanged.
- Cache original rizin/Ghidra archives under new digest-specific namespaces and verify the same archive before cleanup/extraction on every applicable run. Four authored Bash fixtures exercise the actual workflow steps without downloading or executing native tools.
- Repair the cache test's incomplete rizin step heading and require a valid original workflow before each of its 14 negative mutations. Fix three actual Ruff findings; preserve their original failure receipts.
- Add a Pages deploy-only `[no deploy]` push-head veto. Ordinary unmarked pushes, manual dispatch, build/test/artifact flow and permissions remain as specified.
- Recover all 20 missing PR #346 engineering/evidence files with exact blob verification, update the six required indexes and authoritative ledger, and retain the source history bundle and complete paginated census.

## Executed verification

Clean combined source `e5a531668ef523cd6faa26d5fec59aa552749134` / tree `e622ff8f5624ce73bac63c0976af01c614ce05bb`:

- Normal-conftest offscreen selection across 14 maintained files: **458 passed, 11 skipped, 2 xfailed**.
- All 11 skips were missing declared site-build dependencies. Installed pinned Pillow/segno and replayed exactly those identities: **11 passed** on the same clean source.
- **469 distinct passing identities, zero remaining selection skips, two unchanged CODEX-1/CODEX-5 expected failures.** This is a bounded selection; author/peer repeats are not added.
- Whole-tree Ruff, dependency checks and patch whitespace passed. Independent spec/standards reviews and final record audit found no blocking finding in the reviewed scopes.
- Nine workflow/test/tool blob comparisons and unchanged application/harness runtime identity verified. The evidence archive's 100 payloads and nine-commit local-source bundle verified.

PR #348's separate hosted source passed full Linux QA (24,043 passed / 53 skipped / 6 xfailed), full Windows QA (23,916 passed / 181 skipped / 5 xfailed), Qt, native and packaging checks. These counts overlap and do not qualify this newer workflow source. PR #345's original NSIS HTTP 503 and its single successful retry are both retained.

## Publication identity

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Intended base at publication | `fdc2696c23bdbfe7668348f25e3b336ce33039f7` |
| Tested local code checkpoint | `e5a531668ef523cd6faa26d5fec59aa552749134` |
| Tree-identical REST code checkpoint | `e15584e2fe474ddcbe01501d380d626cc00c8402` |
| Final local documentation/evidence head | `43b7b99706b91d7320497d35fda8ee87e7195f3f` |
| Final published head | `11f51c105bf63946f59373ae605b937c4fee607a` |
| Complete final tree, equal locally/remotely | `4939056ceb0e02b419c820b9e5748c869c40a857` |

REST publication preserves complete trees and mapped parent relationships. The original local commit history is retained in the verified bundle; no other branch was rebased, force-pushed or deleted.

## Merge and acceptance boundaries

**New-head hosted qualification is pending. Merge only after applicable checks and blocking findings are resolved, using a fresh expected-head REST guard. The actual resulting main merge commit must contain `[no release] [no deploy]`.** PR metadata or ancestor markers alone do not control the resulting push. Release and deployment remain unauthorized; QA and Actions build artifacts stay enabled.

Keep real Tier R cache restore/save/cache-hit and Ghidriff-path acceptance explicit; local fixtures do not establish it. Both actual Linux frozen CLI jobs are required on the new source. CODEX-1/5, manual Windows/trust/accessibility, native Qt advisory disposition, raw index membership, historical semantic review and separate L1/L2/L3 evidence gates remain open. No new empirical accuracy or release-ready claim.

## Records

- [Current report](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/11f51c105bf63946f59373ae605b937c4fee607a/docs/engineering/cycle3-consolidation-20261121-95fe.md)
- [Authoritative ledger](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/11f51c105bf63946f59373ae605b937c4fee607a/docs/engineering/task-ledger.json)
- [Evidence and independent reviews](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/11f51c105bf63946f59373ae605b937c4fee607a/docs/engineering/evidence/cycle3-95fe/README.md)
- [Handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/11f51c105bf63946f59373ae605b937c4fee607a/docs/engineering-handoffs/cycle3-20261121-95fe.md)
